(define (game-tree-grundy n allowed depth)
  (if (or (<= n 0) (<= depth 0))
      (list 'position n 'grundy 0 'terminal #t)
      (let* ((succs (filter (lambda (m) (>= m 0))
                            (map (lambda (s) (- n s)) allowed)))
             (succ-trees (map (lambda (m) (game-tree-grundy m allowed (- depth 1))) succs))
             (succ-grundys (map (lambda (t) (cadr (assoc 'grundy t))) succ-trees))
             (g (game/mex succ-grundys)))
        (list 'position n 'grundy g 'successors succ-trees))))

(define (find-winning-move-grundy n allowed)

    (if (= g 0)
        '(losing-position)
        (let loop ((moves allowed))
          (if (null? moves)
              '(no-move-found)
              (let* ((move (car moves))
                     (after (- n move)))
                (if (and (>= after 0) (= (grundy-subtraction after allowed) 0))
                    (list 'subtract move 'leaving after)

;; Nodes are ALISTS ((position n) (value v) (children ...)) so that assoc
;; (which keys on the car of each pair) can read them.
(define (nim-tree-restricted n max-take depth player)
  (if (or (<= n 0) (<= depth 0))
      (list (list 'position n) (list 'value (if (= n 0) (if (eq? player 'max) -1 1) 0)) (list 'terminal #t))
      (let* ((moves (filter (lambda (t) (<= t n)) (comb/range 1 (+ max-take 1))))
             (children (map (lambda (t) (nim-tree-restricted (- n t) max-take (- depth 1)
                                                             (if (eq? player 'max) 'min 'max)))
                            moves))
             (child-vals (map (lambda (c) (cadr (assoc 'value c))) children))
             (value (if (eq? player 'max) (apply max child-vals) (apply min child-vals))))
        (list (list 'position n) (list 'player player) (list 'value value) (list 'children children)))))

(define (optimal-move-from-tree tree)
  (let* ((value (cadr (assoc 'value tree)))
         (children (cadr (assoc 'children tree)))
         (child-vals (map (lambda (c) (cadr (assoc 'value c))) children)))
    (let loop ((cs children) (vs child-vals) (i 0))
      (if (null? cs)
          '(no-move)
          (if (= (car vs) value)
              (list 'move i 'to (cadr (assoc 'position (car cs))))
              (loop (cdr cs) (cdr vs) (+ i 1)))))))

(define (best-response-row matrix col-choice)
  (let ((r0-payoff (car (list-ref (car matrix) col-choice)))
        (r1-payoff (car (list-ref (cadr matrix) col-choice))))
    (if (> r0-payoff r1-payoff) 0 1)))

(define (best-response-col matrix row-choice)
  (let* ((row (list-ref matrix row-choice))
         (c0-payoff (cadr (car row)))
         (c1-payoff (cadr (cadr row))))
    (if (> c0-payoff c1-payoff) 0 1)))

(define (is-pure-nash? matrix r c)
  (and (= r (best-response-row matrix c))
       (= c (best-response-col matrix r))))

;; --- Nim Game Tree: recursive tree showing all positions ---

(define (nim-game-tree heaps depth)
  (if (<= depth 0)
      (list 'heaps heaps 'nim-sum (game/nim-sum heaps) 'outcome (game/nim-outcome heaps) 'terminal #t)
      (let* ((nim-sum (game/nim-sum heaps))
             (outcome (game/nim-outcome heaps))
             (moves (let loop ((i 0) (acc '()))
                      (if (>= i (length heaps))
                          (reverse acc)
                          (let* ((pile (list-ref heaps i))
                                 (takes (comb/range 1 (+ pile 1))))
                            (loop (+ i 1)
                                  (append acc (map (lambda (t)
                                                     (let ((new-heaps (map (lambda (j h)
                                                                             (if (= j i) (- h t) h))
                                                                           (comb/range 0 (length heaps))
                                                                           heaps)))
                                                       (list (list 'pile i) (list 'take t) (list 'result new-heaps))))
                                                   takes)))))))
             (children (map (lambda (move)
                              (nim-game-tree (cadr (assoc 'result move)) (- depth 1)))
                            moves)))
        (list 'heaps heaps 'nim-sum nim-sum 'outcome outcome 'depth depth 'children children))))

;; --- Find and display the winning path ---

(define (winning-path heaps)
  (let ((nim-sum (game/nim-sum heaps)))
    (if (= nim-sum 0)
        (list 'position-is-losing)
        (let loop ((i 0))
          (if (>= i (length heaps))
              '(error-no-move)
              (let* ((pile (list-ref heaps i))
                     (desired (game/nim-sum (list pile nim-sum))))
                (if (and (>= desired 0) (< desired pile))
                    (let* ((move (list 'pile i 'remove (- pile desired)))
                           (new-heaps (map (lambda (j h) (if (= j i) desired h))
                                           (comb/range 0 (length heaps))
                                           heaps))
                           (new-nim (game/nim-sum new-heaps)))
                      (list 'from heaps 'move move 'to new-heaps 'new-nim-sum new-nim 'outcome 'opponent-loses))
                    (loop (+ i 1)))))))))
